info.title: OCPF Public API
info.description: Public API for Massachusetts Office of Campaign and Political Finance (OCPF) data. Provides access to campaign finance filings, filer information, contributions, expenditures, and more.

get.summary:
Get year-to-date financial reports for mayoral candidates using depository accounts.
Returns receipts, expenditures, and cash on hand for mayoral races.

Get year-to-date financial reports for city council candidates.
Returns depository account activity including receipts, expenditures, and cash on hand.

Get legislative race depository reports (2020 and later). Returns year-to-date financial
activity for legislative candidates organized by district and display group.

Get year-to-date financial reports for Political Action Committees (PACs).
Returns PAC activity including receipts, expenditures, and cash on hand.
